gui.spwallet.description.join_to_server: To open wallet screen you need to play on SP/SPm server
gui.spwallet.description.delete_card.too: Card will only be removed from the mod
gui.spwallet.description.save_card.toolt: Changing the card name only affects the mod
modal.spwallet.delete_card.description: Are you sure you want to delete card
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.spwallet: Mod that allows you to manage your SP/SPm cards directly in Minecraft
config.spwallet.option.capture_card_mess: When the server prints its card management message in chat, offer to add that card to the wallet.
config.spwallet.option.sign_payments.des: Right clicking a sign with the key held opens the wallet with the transfer prefilled.
config.spwallet.option.force_gui_scale.d: While the wallet is open, force GUI scale 2, which is the scale the screen is laid out for.
gui.spwallet.description.copy_card_numbe: Click to copy the card number
command.spwallet.api.unknown_card: No card named "%s". Pass a saved card name, or server/name.
Right clicking a player with the key held opens the wallet to transfer to their card.
config.spwallet.option.qr_payments.descr: Right clicking a framed map with the key held reads the QR code on it. The scan key also reads a held map or, failing that, the whole screen. "Card 79907" or "Transfer Nick" opens the transfer, a link asks to be opened, any other text is shown in your chat only.
config.spwallet.option.theme.description: How the mod's screens and card panels are drawn. Changes right away.
config.spwallet.option.hud_enabled.descr: Shows the balances of your favourite cards while playing - the ones starred on the inventory panel. With none starred there is no panel. Balances refresh once a minute.
config.spwallet.option.hud_position.desc: Opens a screen where the balance panel and the incoming money notifications can be dragged with the mouse.
config.spwallet.option.inventory_panel.d: Shows all of your saved cards with their numbers and balances next to the inventory. Clicking a card stars it, and starred cards are the ones shown on the HUD.
config.spwallet.option.inventory_panel_s: Which side of the inventory the card panel is on. It can also be switched with the ⇄ button on the panel, or dragged anywhere by its header. It keeps clear of the list of active effects.
gui.spwallet.panel.drag: Drag by the header to put the panel anywhere
gui.spwallet.description.hud_position: Drag the panels with the mouse. Esc saves.
config.spwallet.option.payment_sound.des: Plays a sound when a transfer goes through. Which one is picked below; a resource pack can also replace the default as spwallet:payment_success.
config.spwallet.option.payment_sound_cho: Pick the sound from the built-in ones, your own files in config/spwallet/audios (.ogg or .wav), or .ogg files a resource pack puts in assets/spwallet/sounds/custom/.
config.spwallet.option.payment_sound_vol: How loud the mod's sounds are: the payment one and the incoming money one. The game's "Interface" volume slider applies on top of it.
gui.spwallet.description.sound_picker: Click a sound to pick it and hear it
gui.spwallet.description.sound_picker_fo: Your own .ogg and .wav files: the audios folder
config.spwallet.group.incoming.descripti: A stopgap until the SPWorlds API can list transactions: the mod checks your cards' balances every few seconds and tells you when one goes up. It shows how much came in since the last check, not who sent it.
config.spwallet.option.incoming_notifica: Shows a notification (bottom left by default, movable with "Move the HUD elements") when a card's balance goes up. Checks every saved card of the current server - one API request per card per check. The ♪ button next to a card in the wallet turns it off for that card alone.
config.spwallet.option.incoming_check_se: How often the balances are checked. Each check costs one API request per card, and the API allows 200 a minute: with many cards the checks are spaced out on their own so they never take more than 150 a minute (at 5 seconds that is up to 12 cards).
config.spwallet.option.incoming_sound.de: Plays a sound with the notification.
config.spwallet.option.incoming_sound_ch: Pick it from the same list as the payment sound: built-in sounds, your files in config/spwallet/audios and resource pack sounds.
gui.spwallet.card.incoming_on: ♪ Incoming money is announced for this card. Click to turn off
gui.spwallet.card.incoming_off: ♪ No incoming money notifications for this card. Click to turn on
